data.description:
Grok: To understand something intuitively or by empathy. 

Grokit is a hand tracking multiplayer mixed reality game aimed at rapid fire interactions.  Inspired by the party games of old, players are dropped into bizarre situations where they must evaluate their environment and act in a short amount of time. 

Play in your own room with mixed reality passthrough or in traditional virtual reality in a variety of handcrafted environments. 

Grokit is built from the ground up to leverage more of what the new hardware can do. See what’s possible with scene understanding, with game objects interacting with your and your friends’ rooms and furniture. Fast and smooth hand tracking means no more dealing with controllers.

Play your way, with multiple character customization options available for avatars, hats, and watches, as well as a selection of environments and music. 

Grokit is also an excellent way to introduce your friends to VR and MR because it’s easy to pick up, or grok, and the engaging challenges can be enjoyed in short play sessions. Perfect for family gatherings!

This is just the beginning of our Grokit journey. Future updates will include additional micro-levels, longer content mini-levels, more customization options, holiday and other special events, mobile asymmetrical play, and more, oh my!

Grokit is a work in progress, with much more content coming, buy now to help support development!

changelog.change_log:
- Shoot other players in Shooter games!
- Menu improvements - layout and positioning updates
- Friends list - join friends directly in game
- Curated Playlists - start up games faster with a selection of curated playlists
- 3d Tutorials - new tutorials at the start of the games
- Various fixes and QoL improvements

It's the holiday season, so it's time for the return of Grokit Winter Blast! ❄️

Go head to head with your friends in holiday themed versions of your favorite Grokit Games:

🌲 DECORATE Christmas trees & see who can hang the most ornaments
🎁 DELIVER presents into windows to keep the kids happy
💥 PASS the ornament bomb around, but don't be the one holding it when it goes BOOM
🐱 RIP your presents open with your cat claws, but don't shatter the bulbs!!
☃️ BLAST as many snowmen as you can by firing snowballs from your hands

This update also fixes a slew of odds and ends behind the scene to make for a smoother overall experience.
We've also made it easier than ever to get into multiplayer with your friends. Simply create a  multiplayer game, then use the friend invite option in the Quest universal menu to invite everyone directly. That's it! Then you're ready to Grok and roll! 

Many features are new and experimental, including direct game invites. Please reach out on our Discord if you run into any issues!

We appreciate any feedback, please be sure to let us know what you think. Horizon Store reviews are the best way to support Grokit and to help us make the game even better. If you haven't yet, be sure to drop a review on our store page!

Happy holidays and happy grokking!

Fall Update
- Cat head options
- Witch hat
- New emojis, cats and dragons
- Claws Out Halloween returns

- Audio system update
- Systems updates (game selector, game info, options buttons)
- Ready check/skip button for games

- Menu button colors

- Public rooms are working again
- Boundary suppression in passthrough

New Micro Games
- Void Feeder: Inspired by our single player adventure, Vault of Stars, Grokit now includes a Vault-themed version of the Feeder game, with shadow motes and void portals.
- Golem Smash - Get into a golem body and use the powerful stony fists to reach out and squish the invading shadow motes.

- In-Game Voice automatically lets players join voice channels when they join a room.
- Microbot Companion gets a voice and brings helpful tips to players
- Left-Handed option for improved accessibility
- Player Game List Filter to search Grokit’s growing games list more easily
- New Vault of Stars based Environment and Music
- Expanded Customization: Personalize your gaming experience with new cosmetics, including Vault of Stars-themed accessories and all-new expressive emojis.

- With a high latency host (whomever creates the room), some of the game behavior can get less responsive to other players. Whomever has the best connection should host.
